mapper.sql: SELECT b.id, b.user_id, b.category_id, b.period_type, b.period_start, b.period_end, b.amount_limit, b.alert_threshold, b.created_at, b.updated_at, c.id AS cat_id, c.code AS cat_code, c.type AS cat_type, c.name AS cat_name, c.icon AS cat_icon, c.color AS cat_color, c.sort_order AS cat_sort_order, c.is_active AS cat_is_active FROM budgets b INNER JOIN categories c ON c.id = b.category_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO budgets (user_id, category_id, period_type, period_start, period_end, amount_limit, alert_threshold) VALUES (#{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{periodType}, #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd}, #{amountLimit}, #{alertThreshold})
